name: Scapesome
tagline: Preview your planted aquarium grown in from the 3D layout you arrange.
description:
Scapesome is a desktop aquarium planner for planted-tank hobbyists. Build a tank in real-size 3D by placing rocks, driftwood, aquatic plants and fish by hand. Turn and resize each piece, compare arrangements, and use AI grown-in images to preview the same layout at a chosen month and angle. Whole-tank reviews and follow-up questions help you explore species compatibility, lighting and setup constraints before buying materials.

Planning is free with an account. Grown-in images, reviews and follow-up questions use credits. The public element library and aquarium volume, substrate and stocking calculators can be used without signing in.
